title: Emergent Language as an Approach to Conscious AI
abstract: arXiv:2606.06380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The question of whether artificial systems can be conscious remains open, in part because existing approaches either evaluate systems against theory-derived checklists (discriminative) or engineer consciousness-inspired modules directly (architectural); both leave open whether observed structures are artifacts of human language priors. We propose a generative methodology: emergent language (EL) in multi-agent reinforcement learning, where agents start from minimal (no language, no concept of self, minimal exposure to human text) and develop communication under task pressure alone, ensuring causal attributability to task demands ratherthan inherited human language priors. We position our methodology by discussing how EL serves as a generative tool for studying consciousness-relevant structure, including the role of environment complexity and the interpretation of emergent communication. translated_title: 涌现语言作为通往意识人工智能的途径
translated_abstract: 人工系统是否具有意识这一问题至今悬而未决，部分原因在于现有方法要么依据理论推导出的清单对系统进行评估（判别式方法），要么直接工程化构建受意识启发的模块（架构式方法）；这两种方法都无法排除所观察到的结构究竟是人类语言先验的产物。我们提出一种生成式方法论：多智能体强化学习中的涌现语言（EL），其中智能体从最低限度的初始状态出发（没有语言、没有自我概念、极少接触人类文本），仅在任务压力下发展出交流能力，从而确保相关结构可因果地归因于任务需求，而非继承自人类语言先验。我们通过讨论涌现语言如何作为研究意识相关结构的生成性工具来确立本方法论的定位，包括环境复杂度的作用以及对涌现交流的解读。作为概念验证，我们实例化了这一……
tldr: 提出一种生成式方法论：让多智能体强化学习中从零开始的智能体仅凭任务压力自发发展出交流语言，从而在摆脱人类语言先验干扰的条件下研究生成意识相关结构的涌现。
en_tdlr: Proposes a generative methodology where emergent language in multi-agent reinforcement learning allows minimally-initialized agents to develop communication solely under task pressure, enabling the study of consciousness-relevant structures free from inherited human language priors.
